import unittest
from unittest.mock import Mock
from requests import PreparedRequest

class TestRedirects(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_rebuild_auth_cross_domain(self):
        req = PreparedRequest('http://other.com/resource', {'Authorization': 'Bearer 123'})
        resp = Mock(url='http://example.com/login')
        req.rebuild_auth(req, resp)
        self.assertNotIn('Authorization', req.headers)

    def test_rebuild_auth_same_domain(self):
        req = PreparedRequest('http://example.com/dashboard', {'Authorization': 'Bearer 123'})
        resp = Mock(url='http://example.com/login')
        req.rebuild_auth(req, resp)
        self.assertIn('Authorization', req.headers)

if __name__ == '__main__': unittest.main()
